name: Get Questionnaires from non terminated actions
description: Get the questionnaires of the not completed workflow actions of the given action type on an incident or request

action_type_id.description: Action type ID (tenant-specific); not the action type GUID
action_type_id.title: Action Type Id

results.description: Questionnaire items, returned unchanged: REQUEST_ID, ACTION_ID, ACTION_TYPE_ID, WORKFLOW_ID (strings) and QUESTION_LIST_ID (string or null); may contain duplicates; to read a questionnaire, use the EasyVista GET /questionnaires/{QUESTION_LIST_ID} endpoint, not exposed by this module
